description: Need plugin-owned query metadata bag to replace VectorField, VectorTarget, VectorMaxDistance, and VectorMetric properties on LiteDB.Engine.Query.Query.
proposedSolution: Extend the plugin system with a query-state bag or strongly typed accessor so vector plugins can persist planning metadata without core-owned fields.
backwardCompatibility: Maintain current query planners by mapping legacy properties into the plugin bag until all call sites adopt the extensibility API; ensure existing queries execute without plugin by surfacing clear errors.
